subject: def
title: (R)DEF.------ AF.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 184 (SR(TRS)II-40). DEF (definition) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: PRIN-INFO and AFI (affinity insight). From PRIN-INFO: SPI-GH. From AFI: POST (postulation). From SPI-GH: PART (participation). From PART: ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ATTN: PHY-U-C (physical universe context) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: P-PROG (particular progressionalism).
